about.heading: About
about.bio_heading: I spent 10 years inside Berlin's cultural scene.
about.bio_1: As Technical Manager at the Berliner Festspiele, Gropius Bau and Volksbühne, I learned how these institutions work — what they need, what drives them, and what they can't afford.
about.bio_2: In 2022 I learned to code at Le Wagon Bootcamp in Berlin. Since then I've been building websites and digital experiences — focused on the world I know: culture, art, Berlin.
about.bio_3: coodaa is my studio. Not a generic web agency — precise work for projects that interest me.
about.bio_ai: I work with Claude as a daily development tool. That means faster delivery, fewer errors — and projects that are technically on a level that used to require much bigger budgets.
about.accessibility_text: This website was built to WCAG 2.1 AA standards — with keyboard navigation, sufficient contrast and semantic HTML.
